users.invalidResetLink: This link has expired or has been used. Ask for a new one with Forgot password on the sign-in page.
denma.notFound: There's nothing at this address. If a link in an e-mail brought you here, it may be out of date.
forms.noPublicLists: No public double opt-in lists to make a form for.
import.instructionsHelp: A CSV file, or a ZIP holding one, with these columns. attributes is optional: JSON, with its quotes doubled.
media.uploadHelp: Click to choose files, or drop them here. They upload at once. PNGs over 1 MB are saved as JPEGs, or refused if they have transparent parts.
lists.archivedHelp: Hidden from the lists page, campaigns and forms. It can be brought back any time.
lists.optinHelp: Double opt-in asks people to confirm by e-mail; campaigns go only to those who have.
lists.typeHelp: Public lists can be shown on public pages, such as sign-up forms.
settings.general.adminNotifEmailsHelp: Addresses for notices about imports, campaigns and failures.
settings.general.enablePublicArchiveHelp: Campaigns with Archive on are shown on a public page.
settings.general.enablePublicArchiveRSSC: Otherwise the feed has only titles and links.
settings.general.enablePublicSubPageHelp: A page where people can subscribe to public lists.
settings.general.faviconURLHelp: The icon in browser tabs on public pages (optional).
settings.general.logoURLHelp: Shown on public pages, such as the unsubscribe page (optional).
settings.general.rootURLHelp: The public address, without a slash at the end.
settings.general.sendOptinConfirmHelp: E-mail people to confirm when they sign up to a double opt-in list.
settings.general.showOptinPageHelp: People confirm with a button on a page, not just by opening the link.
subscribers.attribsHelp: Other details, as JSON. For example:
users.twoFANotEnabled: Asks for a code from an app on your phone as well as your password.
campaigns.noSubs: There are no contacts in the selected lists to create the campaign.
campaigns.noSubsToTest: There are no contacts to target.
campaigns.sendTestHelp: Hit Enter after typing an address to add multiple recipients. The addresses must belong to existing contacts.
lists.confirmDelete: Are you sure? This does not delete contacts.
settings.privacy.allowBlocklistHelp: Allow contacts to unsubscribe from all mailing lists and mark themselves as blocklisted?
settings.privacy.allowExportHelp: Allow contacts to export data collected on them?
settings.privacy.allowPrefsHelp: Allow contacts to change preferences such as their names and multiple list subscriptions.
settings.privacy.allowWipeHelp: Allow contacts to delete themselves including their subscriptions and all other data from the database. Campaign views and link clicks are also removed while views and click counts remain (with no contact associated to them) so that stats and analytics are not affected.
settings.performance.batchSizeHelp: The number of contacts to pull from the database in a single iteration. Each iteration pulls contacts from the database, sends messages to them, and then moves on to the next iteration to pull the next batch. This should ideally be higher than the maximum achievable throughput (concurrency * message_rate).
settings.performance.cacheSlowQueriesHel: Only enable this on large databases that have slowed down significantly. Caches list contact counts, dashboard statistics etc.
import.title: Import contacts
globals.messages.emptyState: Nothing here yet, or nothing matches your search.
